text: This solution, Site-specific Coastal Protection Studies addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Singapore between PUB, Singapore’s National Water Agency, National Climate Change Secretariat (NCCS), Building & Construction Authority (BCA), National Environment Agency (NEA), CPG Consultants, Centre of Excellence hosted at NUS with NTU, SUTD, SIT, and and A*STAR. The program was implemented in 2021 and focuses on collaboration, regulation, and raising awareness.
